characters.identity: Tan peaked hat, red scarf, sage jacket, tan mail satchel, dark trousers; consistent across both branches.

props.identity: Single golden battery with pale center and small lightning mark.
Retractable ochre bridge spanning the only gap between river banks.
Sage socket box at the left bridge head; red/teal indicator.
Mountain post station with a gold signal window.

shots.purpose: Original synthetic fixture for resource tradeoff, visible character action and causal world-state change; not an approved user film.
shots.action: Courier approaches a dead bridge, chooses to spend the last cell, inserts it, watches the bridge extend, crosses, and reaches a newly lit station.

story.goal: Deliver the mail to the station across the river.
story.obstacle: The bridge is unpowered and the courier has only one cell.
story.attempt: Choose to power the bridge and insert the cell into the terminal.
story.outcome: The cell remains in the terminal, the bridge extends, the courier crosses, and the station beacon lights.
story.before: One cell held by courier; bridge retracted; courier on left bank; beacon dark.
story.after: No carried cell; cell in terminal; complete bridge; courier on right bank; beacon lit.
